description: Defines classes and functions for managing the multiplayer lobby in the Wesnoth game, including game browsing and lobby UI components.

classes.name: mp::gamebrowser
classes.description: UI component for browsing multiplayer games, displaying game items, and handling user interactions.

classes.name: mp::lobby
classes.description: Main lobby interface managing game list, user actions, and network data processing.

classes.name: mp::lobby::lobby_sorter
classes.description: Comparator class for sorting lobby game entries based on specific columns.

methods.name: mp::gamebrowser::scroll
methods.description: Scrolls the game list to a specified position.

methods.name: mp::gamebrowser::handle_event
methods.description: Handles input events for the game browser.

methods.name: mp::gamebrowser::set_inner_location
methods.description: Sets the inner viewport location for the game list.

methods.name: mp::gamebrowser::set_item_height
methods.description: Sets the height of each game item in the list.

methods.name: mp::gamebrowser::set_game_items
methods.description: Populates the game list with data from configuration objects.

methods.name: mp::gamebrowser::draw
methods.description: Renders the game browser UI.

methods.name: mp::gamebrowser::draw_contents
methods.description: Draws the contents of the game list.

methods.name: mp::gamebrowser::draw_item
methods.description: Draws a specific game item by index.

methods.name: mp::gamebrowser::get_item_rect
methods.description: Returns the rectangle area occupied by a game item.

methods.name: mp::gamebrowser::empty
methods.description: Checks if the game list is empty.

methods.name: mp::gamebrowser::selection_is_joinable
methods.description: Determines if the selected game can be joined.

methods.name: mp::gamebrowser::selection_is_observable
methods.description: Checks if the selected game can be observed.

methods.name: mp::gamebrowser::selected
methods.description: Returns whether a game is selected via double click.

methods.name: mp::gamebrowser::selection
methods.description: Returns the index of the selected game.

methods.name: mp::lobby::process_event
methods.description: Processes user input events in the lobby.

methods.name: mp::lobby::hide_children
methods.description: Hides or shows child UI elements.

methods.name: mp::lobby::layout_children
methods.description: Arranges child UI elements within the lobby.

methods.name: mp::lobby::process_network_data
methods.description: Handles incoming network data related to the lobby.

methods.name: mp::lobby::gamelist_updated
methods.description: Updates the game list display, optionally silently.

methods.name: mp::lobby::lobby_sorter::column_sortable
methods.description: Checks if a column is sortable.

methods.name: mp::lobby::lobby_sorter::less
methods.description: Comparison function for sorting lobby entries.

methods.name: mp::lobby::lobby_sorter::lobby_sorter
methods.description: Constructor for the lobby sorter.
